title: Warehouse Management System Implementation
request_text:
Northwind Foods operates three regional distribution centers and is replacing a 15-year-old on-premise warehouse system that cannot support same-day fulfilment.

Scope and requirements:
- Deliver a cloud-hosted warehouse management system (WMS) for all three sites
- Integrate bidirectionally with our SAP S/4HANA ERP for orders, inventory, and invoicing
- Support barcode and RFID scanning on rugged handheld devices
- Provide real-time inventory visibility by site, zone, and bin
- Migrate 18 months of historical inventory and order data
- Train 200 warehouse staff and 15 supervisors; provide train-the-trainer material
- Provide 24x7 production support with a 1-hour response for severity-1 incidents
- Comply with SOC 2 Type II and our data-retention policy

Timeline: first site live within 6 months of contract signature, all sites within 10 months.
Budget: up to USD 2.4M over three years including licences and services.

Evaluation criteria: functional fit (30%), implementation approach and timeline (25%), total cost of ownership (20%), relevant experience and references (15%), support model (10%).
